acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-01 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The idempotency claim was not atomic, so two concurrent confirms could both orchestrate the same order
findings.current_implementation: idempotencyService.begin relied on saveAndFlush raising DataIntegrityViolationException. JPA merges an entity with an assigned id instead of inserting it, so the exception never fired; the late claimant silently adopted and reset the winner record and begin returned an empty Optional, telling the caller it owned the key.
findings.notes: The reproduction printed stored.responseStatus=0 stored.responseBody=[] for a record that had been completed with status 200, which proves the merge reset it. Severity HIGH.
findings.target_implementation: The claim now runs as a single INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING that returns the affected row count, so exactly one transaction can own a key.
findings.title: The idempotency claim was not atomic, so two concurrent confirms could both orchestrate the same order

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-02 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: Thirteen alert rules referenced metrics the platform never publishes, and the validator never checked metric existence
findings.current_implementation: Rules referenced application_startup_failures_total, kafka_consumergroup_lag, outbox_pending_events_count, payment_webhook_processing_failures_total, inventory_invariant_violations_total and other names that exist nowhere in the source.
findings.notes: The rewritten rule set passes promtool check rules with 18 rules and the live metric audit reports no unknown metric. Severity HIGH.
findings.target_implementation: Every rule now uses a metric confirmed against the live Prometheus inventory, and the validator queries the live metric catalogue and fails a rule that names an unpublished metric.
findings.title: Thirteen alert rules referenced metrics the platform never publishes, and the validator never checked metric existence

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-03 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The final report hard-coded an alerting success claim and printed stale suite results as verified
findings.current_implementation: Section 31 asserted that the alerting infrastructure was fully implemented while the persisted status was FAIL, and sections 32 and 36.1 printed suite PASSes recorded against an earlier source revision.
findings.notes: The report no longer contains a hard-coded alerting sentence. Severity HIGH.
findings.target_implementation: The report derives the alerting status from the persisted result, marks evidence that no longer matches the working tree fingerprint as stale, and never states a success it cannot source.
findings.title: The final report hard-coded an alerting success claim and printed stale suite results as verified

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-04 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: Suite evidence could certify production readiness against a source revision that no longer existed
findings.current_implementation: A suite result carried only a git revision, so results recorded before an edit still satisfied the gates.
findings.notes: A stale suite result now moves its gate to PENDING. Severity HIGH.
findings.target_implementation: Every suite result is stamped with a source fingerprint over the working tree, and a gate only accepts evidence whose fingerprint still matches.
findings.title: Suite evidence could certify production readiness against a source revision that no longer existed

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-05 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: Three business invariants were vacuous or used enum values that do not exist
findings.current_implementation: INV-08 filtered on status RESERVED although the reservation status enum is PENDING, COMMITTED, RELEASED and EXPIRED; INV-07 excluded PARTIALLY_REFUNDED although the payment status enum contains it; INV-06 asserted a uniqueness the schema never promised.
findings.notes: All eight invariants now execute real SQL and report PASS with zero violations against the live database. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The invariants now use the real enum values and assert a business rule the schema actually supports.
findings.title: Three business invariants were vacuous or used enum values that do not exist

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-06 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The load runner reported PASS when the measurement host was contaminated or the invariants were blocked
findings.current_implementation: The runner returned PASS regardless of the host contamination guard and the invariant outcome.
findings.notes: A contaminated run no longer produces a PASS status. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The runner now derives FAIL, BLOCKED or PASS from the k6 exit code, the measurement validity and the invariant outcome.
findings.title: The load runner reported PASS when the measurement host was contaminated or the invariants were blocked

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-07 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The YAML subset parser silently dropped a sequence declared at the same indentation as its key
findings.current_implementation: A mapping key whose value was a sequence at the same indentation parsed as a null value instead of raising, which lets a manifest validate as correct while a list is missing.
findings.notes: The parser rejects the construct rather than returning a null. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The parser now raises a YamlError for that construct instead of dropping the value.
findings.title: The YAML subset parser silently dropped a sequence declared at the same indentation as its key

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-08 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The continuous integration workflow was red on arrival
findings.current_implementation: The kubernetes validation job failed four checks, the alerting validation job exited 2 on the missing credential check, and a new Stripe unit test failed deterministically.
findings.notes: Every job in the workflow is green on the current tree. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The kubernetes checks were repaired, the alerting job treats a blocked credential check as a skip, the Stripe test no longer depends on a local environment file, and the workflow installs the offline schema validator.
findings.title: The continuous integration workflow was red on arrival

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-09 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The Kubernetes manifests declared no startup probe, no pod security context and no disruption budget
findings.current_implementation: A container that cannot serve within the liveness delay would be restarted in a loop, and a voluntary disruption could evict every replica of a service at once.
findings.notes: kubeconform validates 53 resources with 0 errors and the harness reports 13 of 13 kubernetes checks PASS. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: Every workload now declares a startup probe, a pod security context with runAsNonRoot and a seccomp profile, a container security context that drops all capabilities, and a pod disruption budget per service.
findings.title: The Kubernetes manifests declared no startup probe, no pod security context and no disruption budget

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-10 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The circuit breaker state was never exported, so the gateway outage rule could never fire
findings.current_implementation: The resilience4j micrometer binder was absent from the dependency tree, so resilience4j_circuitbreaker_state was never registered.
findings.notes: The metric audit confirms the rule resolves against the published catalogue once the fleet is rebuilt. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The binder is declared in the dependency management and in the gateway service.
findings.title: The circuit breaker state was never exported, so the gateway outage rule could never fire

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-11 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: Request latency percentiles were unmeasurable because the histogram buckets were never published
findings.current_implementation: The distribution configuration only enabled buckets for the server request timer, so the quantile rule had no bucket series to read.
findings.notes: The latency rule resolves against the published catalogue once the fleet is rebuilt. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The distribution configuration now enables histogram buckets for every meter.
findings.title: Request latency percentiles were unmeasurable because the histogram buckets were never published

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-12 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The rendered Alertmanager configuration that carries the live bot token was not ignored by git
findings.current_implementation: The rendering step writes the bot token into config/observability/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml inside the repository.
findings.notes: git status no longer reports the rendered configuration. Severity LOW.
findings.target_implementation: The rendered file is now listed in the git ignore rules.
findings.title: The rendered Alertmanager configuration that carries the live bot token was not ignored by git

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-13 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The Alertmanager template rendering corrupted any value that contained an ampersand
findings.current_implementation: The awk substitution treats an ampersand in the replacement as the matched text, so a chat identifier containing an ampersand produced a corrupted configuration.
findings.notes: A token containing an ampersand and a pipe renders literally. Severity LOW.
findings.target_implementation: The rendering now escapes the backslash, ampersand and delimiter characters and validates the chat identifier before it is written.
findings.title: The Alertmanager template rendering corrupted any value that contained an ampersand

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-14 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The Stripe harness treated any test key prefix as a real credential and certified a placeholder webhook secret
findings.current_implementation: classify_key accepted every string that started with the test prefix, and the webhook check performed a local signature round trip with whatever secret was configured and reported PASS.
findings.notes: The harness now reports the webhook check as BLOCKED with the placeholder secret and the key as a placeholder. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The key classification requires the real secret key shape and reports a placeholder separately, and the webhook check refuses to certify a placeholder secret.
findings.title: The Stripe harness treated any test key prefix as a real credential and certified a placeholder webhook secret

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-15 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The credential scan ignored untracked files and only recognised two credential shapes
findings.current_implementation: The scan used git ls-files without the untracked set and only matched a labelled bot token and a live stripe key, so a credential committed as an unlabelled literal escaped.
findings.notes: The scan reports the file count it examined and the scope it applied. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The scan covers the tracked and untracked working tree and matches unlabelled bot tokens and stripe keys in any configuration file.
findings.title: The credential scan ignored untracked files and only recognised two credential shapes

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-16 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The deployment template shipped usable credential literals for every account the stack requires
findings.current_implementation: The template carried postgres, redis, keycloak, storage, elasticsearch, mail, payment and webhook credentials that a copy and start would provision, including the seeded realm administrator password.
findings.notes: The deployment credential contract test proves the template ships no value and that compose names every missing variable. Severity HIGH.
findings.target_implementation: The template now carries no credential value, compose requires every named credential, the realm bootstrap refuses placeholder values and the payment service refuses a live mode stripe key.
findings.title: The deployment template shipped usable credential literals for every account the stack requires

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-17 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The search client was pinned to the previous elasticsearch major while the fleet client was on the current one
findings.current_implementation: The module pinned the elasticsearch java client at the previous major and added the legacy transport era rest client, so the fleet ran two client majors against one server.
findings.notes: The search module suite passes against the managed server version and a contract test proves no module pins its own client version. Severity HIGH.
findings.target_implementation: The module inherits the managed client version, the legacy rest client is gone and the client is built through the current transport.
findings.title: The search client was pinned to the previous elasticsearch major while the fleet client was on the current one

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-18 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The outbox claim collapsed the candidate range to a single row, so a second replica published nothing
findings.current_implementation: The claim used a MIN(id) subquery that pinned exactly one candidate, so the skip locked range had nothing to advance past and the relay stopped on the first empty claim.
findings.notes: Two relay replicas publish disjoint events and every pending row is published exactly once. Severity HIGH.
source_evidence: the product, inventory, media, rating and promotion service outbox repositories
findings.target_implementation: Each relay now claims a skippable range per tick inside one short transaction that also stamps the lease, and a stale lease is re-armed by the recovery scan.
findings.title: The outbox claim collapsed the candidate range to a single row, so a second replica published nothing

acceptance_criteria: The behaviour reported for ORC-19 no longer reproduces and a regression test proves it
findings.business_risk: The payment relay marked every record by its own outcome, which reordered one partition
findings.current_implementation: A failed capture left a later refund of the same payment marked as sent, so the same aggregate was published out of order.
findings.notes: Twelve events of one payment reach the broker on one partition in creation order. Severity MEDIUM.
findings.target_implementation: The payment relay now uses the fleet ordering barrier so a failed record blocks only the later records of the same aggregate, and a failed record returns to pending for another attempt.
findings.title: The payment relay marked every record by its own outcome, which reordered one partition
